freeze.teacher: Frozen corrected v3 full EV heads from the positive zero-modeled-delay study, one preexisting chronological head pair per fold; no teacher optimization.
freeze.target: Frozen-teacher P(fill)*mean(value|fill) for a new 30-share quote at the SAME absolute price, evaluated at submit time+58ms with zero modeled feed delay at that time. Fresh queue and order features rebuilt there; rejection at activation retained as zero execution value. Missing support is a status, no filled-only population.
freeze.population: One row per placement generation on neutral no-learned-cancel/no-entry-gate path at 58/37ms, both sides/all six rungs. Missing current/future inputs retained as statuses. All zero/fill/rejection outcomes retained where teacher support exists; no performance-based sampling.
freeze.student: Two side-specific LightGBM mean regressions per fold, target arrival teacher score minus current teacher score; inputs 83 current causal fields plus current score. Train only on frozen teacher fold training days, calibration unused, test the same five consumed later dates. 200 rounds, inherited pinned params, no hyperparameter/threshold search.
freeze.policy: Entry score=current teacher score+predicted delta; post iff score>=0. Existing resting EV guard unchanged. Bid/ask separate. Place58 cancel37 pending95 notice100 review50ms, six rungs x30 per side, queueM unknown0 M50 imputed tape, no cap or timer.
freeze.oracle: Arrival score for the current quote candidate, not transplanted order identities. Missing teacher support falls back to incumbent. No claim it reproduces whole zero-delay trajectory or is an upper bound.
freeze.primary: All-fill terminal-marked PnL and cents/share, volume, pulls, exposure; compare paired date changes against incumbent. Every baseline window must reproduce prior medians.
freeze.prediction: On neutral test placements: MAE/MSE, sign accuracy and abs(teacher value)-weighted sign disagreement; compare to current score persistence. This is teacher-score error, not realized value.
freeze.descriptive_predicates: Report pooled teacher disagreement reduction; pooled PnL improvement; positive paired-date count out of5. No significance/validation declaration.
freeze.nulls: No inferential null or significance claim in this descriptive first experiment. Any later skill/null test must predeclare >=200 matched draws and later untouched validation dates.
controls: fixed absolute price vs future rung substitution
freeze.limits: Consumed data. Entry-only first test; cancellation prediction not tested. Neutral births may not cover every later policy entry state. Zero-feed timestamps, queue and imputed trade assumptions inherited; no actual network jitter. Teacher already estimates its frozen original local target; no second cancel-latency shift applied.
freeze.reason: First data build stopped at memory guard before any completed dataset, fit or economic result. Selected row views retained full window matrices. Copying selected rows fixes memory; target/population/model/replay unchanged. Incomplete v1 output preserved.
